Terms and Conditions
Introduction

These terms and conditions govern your use of our website; by using our website, you accept these terms and conditions in full. If you disagree with these terms and conditions or any part of these terms and conditions, you must not use our website.

Charitable Mission & Board Discretion

Homeroom Heroes is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. While our platform facilitates a bridge between donors and specific classroom wishlists, Homeroom Heroes maintains final discretion and control over the use of all directly donated resources. To maintain our charitable status, all donations made via this platform are considered contributions to Homeroom Heroe
